subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Which Feishu whole-message text slash commands should bypass per-chat serialization during an active run?
rationale: Current main deliberately gives `/stop` a control lane while `/status` and `/new` remain on the ordinary chat lane; expanding bypass behavior requires maintainer intent for command authorization, session mutation, and ordering semantics.

options.title: Define the Feishu command-bypass policy
options.body: Keep this open and decide the explicit set of authorized Feishu text commands that may bypass the active same-chat queue before accepting a fix.

options.title: Abort-only bypass
options.body: Treat `/stop` as the only immediate Feishu text command and document or close the remaining `/new` and `/status` expectations separately.

options.title: Fold into broader slash-command tracking
options.body: Move the active-run details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79409 and use that issue as the single Feishu text-command command-turn policy tracker.

recommendation.title: Define the Feishu command-bypass policy
recommendation.body: Keep this open and decide the explicit set of authorized Feishu text commands that may bypass the active same-chat queue before accepting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is command policy across Feishu and core command-turn behavior, and this owner has the strongest local history signal for that boundary.
